gate.title: Behavior & consequences is switched off
gate.adminBody: Nothing is logged, counted or released while it is off. Turning it on only adds this module beside your existing data: it changes no grade and sends no email.
gate.staffBody: Your school has not switched this module on yet, so no incident or consequence can be logged here. Ask a school administrator to turn it on.
gate.enableFailed: The module could not be switched on.

log.title: Log an incident
log.subtitle: The next step is suggested from the ladder. Nothing is sent to anyone automatically.
log.findStudentPlaceholder: Type a name or student id
log.studentCountHint: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} students. Keep typing to narrow the list.
log.noTypesHint: No behavior types are set up yet. Add them in the Setup tab.
log.notesPlaceholder: Describe the behavior in factual terms
log.notesPrivacy: {{words}} words · this note stays internal and is never emailed
log.othersHint: Optional. They are recorded on the incident only, never in a family message.
log.seriousReasonPlaceholder: Why is this treated as serious?
log.seriousReasonRequired: A serious incident needs a reason.
log.overrideReasonPlaceholder: Reason for choosing a different step
log.overrideReasonRequired: Choosing another step requires a reason.
log.overrideHint: Overrides are recorded in the audit trail exactly like the suggestion.
log.duplicateBody: A very similar incident was logged {{when}}, within {{window}} minutes.
log.mergeHint: Merging keeps one incident and one occurrence count. Logging again would count twice.
log.pickStudentAndBehavior: Choose a student and a behavior first.
log.loggedAwaitingApproval: Logged. It waits for approval before any consequence starts.
log.missingParentEmail: No parent email on file, so the family cannot be emailed.
log.flaggedForAdmin: Flagged for an administrator because the ladder is exhausted.

suggestion.emptyBody: Pick a student and a behavior to see the next step, the counting window and the tasks.
suggestion.familyPlanBody: A message is prepared for the family and kept on the incident. Portal visibility follows the ladder. The email goes out only once the step is approved.
suggestion.noTransportNotice: Email leaves only when the step is approved and this school has family email switched on. Until then it stays queued.
suggestion.selectedStudentHint: The suggestion updates as you change the student, the behavior or the date.

approvals.title: Approval queue
approvals.subtitle: Incidents waiting for a decision. Nothing starts and nobody is contacted until you decide.
approvals.notePlaceholder: Optional note for the audit trail
approvals.noteHint: Rejecting always needs a reason. Approving does not.
approvals.rejectedToast: Rejected. The consequence did not start.
approvals.loadFailed: Could not load the approval queue.

tasks.title: Consequence tasks
tasks.subtitle: Work students owe and staff have to verify.
tasks.gatesReturn: Needs to be cleared before the student returns

ledger.title: Incident ledger
ledger.subtitle: Every incident with the step that was applied, the tasks and the audit trail.
ledger.noTransportNotice: These rows show what was sent, what is queued and what is held back.
ledger.voidHint: Voiding removes it from the occurrence count. The record and its history stay.
ledger.resetHint: Resets the counters for this student and behavior. Incidents are never deleted.

setup.rulesSubtitle: How occurrences are counted, who approves and what is drafted.
setup.readOnlyHint: You can review these settings but not change them.
setup.featureHint: While this is off the module stays invisible: no tabs, no jobs, no routes. The legacy tracker is untouched either way.
setup.duplicateWindowHint: Two incidents closer than this are offered as a merge instead of a second occurrence.
setup.approvalDefaultHint: A single step can override this with its own setting.
setup.noAutoSend: Nothing is ever sent on a timeout
setup.noAutoSendBody: When the escalation window passes the request only moves to the backup roles. No message is released automatically.
setup.emailDeliveryHint: Off means every message stays a record: the portal and this workspace still show it, nothing is mailed.
setup.ccRolesHint: These staff are copied on the family email, so the people in charge hold the same thread.
setup.languageHint: Used when the family language is unknown.
setup.deliveryOnNote: Delivery is on for this school
setup.deliveryOnBody: An approved message is sent to the guardians on file and copied to the roles above. A step that is not approved is never sent.
setup.deliveryOffNote: Delivery is off for this school
setup.deliveryOffBody: Messages are prepared and kept as records, and the portal stays the only way a family sees them.
setup.seriousRoles: Roles that may mark an incident serious
setup.seriousRolesHint: Everyone else sees the option greyed out.
setup.apologyWordsHint: Applies to apology letters unless the step sets its own minimum.

countingHints.school_year: Occurrences add up through the academic year and reset when it starts.
countingHints.term: Occurrences reset at every term boundary.
countingHints.rolling_days: Only incidents inside the last N days are counted, so old incidents fade out on their own.
countingHints.manual: Nothing resets on its own. An administrator resets the counters with a reason.

verifierRules.logging-staff: The staff member who logged it

ladder.title: Behavior types and ladders
ladder.subtitle: Each behavior walks its steps in order. Suspension steps are always suggestions for a person to decide.
ladder.typeCreateFailed: Could not create the behavior type.
ladder.typeUpdateFailed: Could not update the behavior type.
ladder.pickHint: Pick a behavior type on the left to edit its steps.
ladder.name: Ladder name
ladder.stepSummaryPlaceholder: Short summary for staff and the portal
ladder.consequenceTitlePlaceholder: What the student has to do
ladder.suspensionHint: Suspension is only ever a suggestion. A person decides.

overflowHints.repeat_last: The final step is offered again for every further incident.
overflowHints.flag_for_admin: The incident is marked so an administrator has to look at it.

templates.title: Message templates
templates.subtitle: These fill the message staff review before it can go out.
templates.empty: No templates yet. The seed creates the default set.
templates.pickHint: Edit the subject and body, then save. Use the chips to insert a variable.
templates.subject: Subject

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Counts, steps, tasks and approval latency for the selected range.
reports.emailNoticeBody: Queued or held: {{value}}. Nothing leaves while this school's email switch is off.
reports.emailNoticeLiveBody: Sent: {{sent}}. Queued: {{queued}}. Failed: {{failed}}. Every send still needs the step's approval.
